title: FedSocket: Recipient-Executable Knowledge Exchange for Heterogeneous Multimodal Federated Learning
abstract: arXiv:2609.37582v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Federated knowledge must remain usable by recipients with different modalities, private architectures, and tasks. We present FedSocket, which makes recipient execution a design requirement of the exchanged model. A shared Q combines recipient-computable inputs, task-owned outputs, and ownership-aware aggregation, connecting heterogeneous private models through a common prediction interface. Private models teach local Q copies; the returned Q supports local learning and Joint inference, with only Q parameters and counts exchanged. Across six datasets, FedSocket improves missing-modality recipient accuracy over Local by 14.44 and 15.51 percentage points on MELD and UCF-51. Under matched inference capacity, Joint exceeds independent ensembles by 11.06 points in UCF-51 accuracy and 4.87 points in mean bidirectional Flickr30k R@1. translated_title: FedSocket：面向异构多模态联邦学习的接收方可执行知识交换
translated_abstract: 联邦知识必须能够被拥有不同模态、私有架构和任务的接收方继续使用。我们提出了FedSocket，它将接收方可执行性作为被交换模型的一项设计要求。一个共享的Q模块将接收方可计算的输入、任务方自有的输出以及具有所有权感知的聚合结合在一起，通过统一的预测接口连接异构的私有模型。私有模型负责训练本地的Q副本；返回的Q既支持本地学习也支持联合推理，且仅需要交换Q的参数和计数信息。在六个数据集上的实验表明，FedSocket在MELD和UCF-51上将缺失模态接收方的准确率相比本地训练分别提升了14.44和15.51个百分点。在推理容量匹配的条件下，联合推理在UCF-51准确率上超过独立集成方法11.06个百分点，在Flickr30k平均双向R@1上超过4.87个百分点。联合推理在全部四个异构端点上也优于单独使用Q，证明了结合本地学习与共享知识的价值。
tldr: FedSocket通过一个共享的、接收方可执行的Q模块连接异构私有模型，在多模态联邦学习中仅交换轻量的Q参数即可显著提升缺失模态等异构接收方的性能。
en_tdlr: FedSocket makes exchanged knowledge recipient-executable in heterogeneous multimodal federated learning via a shared Q module, yielding large gains (up to 15.51 points) for missing-modality recipients while exchanging only lightweight Q parameters.
